title: QSOT2 -- mathematical-consistency verifier
summary: QSOT2 is the mathematical-verification line of the QSOT program, migrated clean from the QSOT V2 model and harness with separated git history. It runs a 6-phase, 35-check pipeline over six spacetime backgrounds and emits a lean machine-readable result (qsot2.math_consistency.experiment_result.v1) carrying a 4-field claim boundary. Curvature drives a single-qubit channel map; purity, entropy, a flat-relative KD proxy, and a TTM-inspired backflow self-test are computed and checked, and the five temporal-state axioms hold to machine epsilon. The DEGRADED_PASS verdict is honest: the flat-baseline KD optimization does not converge within its fixed budget. Governance (phase6) is moved to experimental/ and excluded from the verdict.
findings: 34/35 checks passed, 0 skipped, 1 degraded (overall KD non-convergence) -- surfaced, not hidden
Verdict limited to model-output consistency only -- no external physical validity claimed

0057's null KD/nm placeholders replaced by a flat-relative KD delta (+0.1230) and a bounded backflow self-test (nm = 1.41e-4) cleanly separated from the Markovian-by-construction model trajectory (nm = 0)

0057's absent curved-spacetime computation replaced by deterministic per-background purity (Schwarzschild 0.99943, de Sitter 0.63607, AdS5 0.67764, Eguchi-Hanson 0.99887) under an explicit phenomenological ansatz
Numeric parity with QSOT-Harness r1 (now 0059) preserved through the clean migration; verified by the lean-schema result hash efca2228
